entities.orderNumber: Human-readable sequence number displayed to customers.
entities.confirmationNumber: Unique reference code generated upon successful checkout.
entities.customerId: Unique identifier for the customer associated with the order.
entities.email: Email address where order notifications are sent.
entities.phone: Phone number associated with the order contact.
entities.financialStatus: Payment state of the order (e.g., paid, pending, refunded).
entities.fulfillmentStatus: Shipping state of the order items (e.g., fulfilled, unfulfilled).
entities.createdAt: Timestamp when the order was created.
entities.updatedAt: Timestamp when the order was last modified.
entities.processedAt: Timestamp when the order was processed.
entities.cancelledAt: Timestamp when the order was cancelled.
entities.closedAt: Timestamp when the order was archived or closed.
entities.cancelReason: Explanation or cause for order cancellation.
entities.totalPrice: Final total amount charged for the order including tax and shipping.
entities.subtotalPrice: Total price of items before taxes, shipping, and discounts.
entities.totalTax: Total calculated tax amount for the order.
entities.totalDiscounts: Total monetary discount applied to the order.
entities.totalShippingPrice: Total cost charged for shipping the order.
entities.currencyCode: Three-letter ISO currency code for financial values.
entities.billingAddress: Billing address details provided by the purchaser.
entities.shippingAddress: Destination address for delivering physical goods.
entities.lineItemId: Unique identifier for a specific line item within the order.
entities.fulfillmentId: Unique identifier for the fulfillment group.
entities.fulfillmentOrderId: Identifier linking to the fulfillment order object.
entities.trackingNumber: Carrier tracking number for the shipment.
entities.trackingNumbers: Collection of all tracking numbers associated with the fulfillment.
entities.trackingCompany: Name of the shipping carrier or service provider.
entities.trackingUrl: Direct URL link to track the shipment status.
entities.trackingUrls: Collection of direct tracking links for the shipment.
entities.locationId: Unique identifier for the fulfillment or inventory location.
entities.refundId: Unique identifier for a refund issued against the order.
entities.transactionId: Unique identifier for the payment gateway transaction.
entities.note: Internal notes or remarks attached to the order.
entities.tags: Custom comma-separated keywords or labels assigned to the order.

entities.productId: Unique identifier for the product master record.
entities.productVariantId: Unique identifier for a specific variation of a product.
entities.variantId: Alternative reference identifier for a product variant.
entities.productTitle: Display name of the parent product.
entities.title: Display name of the product or variant.
entities.handle: URL-friendly unique string identifier for the product page.
entities.vendor: Manufacturer, brand, or supplier name of the product.
entities.productType: Category category classification assigned to the product.
entities.status: Publication state of the product (e.g., active, draft, archived).
entities.tags: Custom categorical keywords associated with the product.
entities.sku: Stock Keeping Unit code for inventory tracking.
entities.barcode: UPC, ISBN, or EAN barcode string.
entities.option: Product option attribute grouping (e.g., Size, Color).
entities.optionId: Unique identifier for a product option.
entities.optionName: Name of the product option type.
entities.optionValue: Specific assigned value for a product option.
entities.optionValues: Collection of available values for a product option.
entities.price: Selling price of the product variant.
entities.compareAtPrice: Original or list price used to show discounts.
entities.currencyCode: Three-letter ISO currency code for product pricing.
entities.inventoryQuantity: Total stock units available in inventory.
entities.inventoryItemId: Unique identifier tracking the inventory stock item.
entities.weight: Physical mass or heaviness of the product variant.
entities.weightUnit: Unit of measurement for weight (e.g., kg, lb).
entities.requiresShipping: Indicates whether the product needs to be physically shipped.
entities.taxable: Indicates whether taxes apply to the product purchase.
entities.imageId: Unique identifier for the associated product image.
entities.mediaId: Unique identifier for rich media content (images, videos).
entities.collectionId: Unique identifier for a product collection or group.
entities.categoryId: Unique identifier for a standardized product category.
entities.categoryName: Name of the standardized product category.

entities.lineItemId: Unique identifier for the order line item.
entities.orderId: Unique identifier for the parent order.
entities.productId: Unique identifier for the purchased product.
entities.variantId: Unique identifier for the purchased product variant.
entities.sku: Stock Keeping Unit code of the ordered item.
entities.title: Name of the product or variant purchased.
entities.quantity: Number of units ordered for this line item.
entities.currentQuantity: Active unrefunded quantity remaining for the line item.
entities.originalUnitPrice: Base unit price of the item before discounts.
entities.discountedUnitPrice: Final unit price of the item after applying discounts.
entities.requiresShipping: Indicates if the line item requires physical delivery.
entities.taxable: Indicates if taxes are applicable to the line item.
entities.fulfillmentStatus: Fulfillment state of this specific line item.

entities.query: Free-text search string for filtering products.
entities.first: Limits the number of results returned from the start of the list.
entities.after: Cursor string used for pagination forward through results.
entities.last: Limits the number of results returned from the end of the list.
entities.before: Cursor string used for pagination backward through results.
entities.sortKey: Field attribute used to order search results.
entities.reverse: Boolean flag to invert the sort order direction.
entities.vendor: Filter products by manufacturer or brand name.
entities.collectionId: Filter products belonging to a specific collection.
entities.createdAt: Filter products based on creation timestamp.
entities.updatedAt: Filter products based on last update timestamp.
entities.publishedAt: Filter products based on publication timestamp.
entities.tag: Filter products containing a specific tag.
entities.sku: Filter products matching a specific SKU.
entities.barcode: Filter products matching a specific barcode.
entities.price: Filter products matching a specific price.
entities.minPrice: Minimum price threshold for filtering products.
entities.maxPrice: Maximum price threshold for filtering products.
entities.available: Filter products based on inventory availability.
entities.inventoryQuantity: Filter products matching specific stock quantities.

entities.customerId: Unique identifier for the customer profile.
entities.email: Primary email address for customer communication.
entities.phone: Primary telephone contact number for the customer.
entities.lastName: Family name or surname of the customer.
entities.displayName: Full formatted name of the customer for display purposes.
entities.company: Business or organization name associated with the customer.
entities.companyId: Unique identifier for the associated company account.
entities.address: Primary physical address details of the customer.
entities.addressId: Unique identifier for a specific customer address record.
entities.country: Country name in the customer address.
entities.countryCode: Two-letter ISO country code for the customer address.
entities.province: State, province, or region within the customer address.
entities.city: City or locality name in the customer address.
entities.zip: Postal code or ZIP code for the customer address.
entities.tags: Custom categorical labels or tags assigned to the customer.
entities.note: Internal administrative notes regarding the customer.
entities.state: Account lifecycle state of the customer profile.
entities.createdAt: Timestamp when the customer profile was created.
entities.updatedAt: Timestamp when the customer profile was last updated.
entities.acceptsMarketing: Indicates whether the customer opted in to marketing emails.
entities.marketingConsent: Detailed tracking status of marketing permissions and consent.
entities.taxExempt: Indicates whether the customer is exempt from paying taxes.

entities.fulfillmentId: Unique identifier for the fulfillment record.
entities.fulfillmentOrderId: Identifier linking to the source fulfillment order.
entities.orderId: Unique identifier for the parent order being fulfilled.
entities.locationId: Identifier of the warehouse or location fulfilling the items.
entities.trackingNumber: Carrier tracking code assigned to the shipment.
entities.trackingNumbers: Collection of all tracking codes associated with the fulfillment.
entities.trackingCompany: Name of the logistics or shipping carrier.
entities.trackingUrl: Direct URL link to view shipment tracking status.
entities.trackingUrls: Collection of direct tracking links for the shipment.
entities.status: Current progress state of the fulfillment.
entities.notifyCustomer: Flag determining whether to send a shipping notification email.
entities.lineItems: Collection of line items included in this fulfillment batch.
entities.service: Name of the shipping service provider used.
entities.serviceId: Unique identifier for the shipping service.

entities.returnId: Unique identifier for the product return request.
entities.orderId: Unique identifier for the parent order related to the return.
entities.returnLineItemId: Unique identifier for a line item being returned.
entities.lineItemId: Identifier linking back to the original order line item.
entities.returnReason: Categorized reason given for why the item is being returned.
entities.returnReasonNote: Detailed textual explanation provided for the return.
entities.returnStatus: Current workflow state of the return request.
entities.returnProcessStatus: Processing status stage of the returned goods.
entities.refundId: Unique identifier for the associated financial refund.
entities.refundAmount: Monetary value refunded to the customer.
entities.refundCurrency: Three-letter ISO currency code for the refund amount.
entities.refundNote: Internal or customer-facing explanation for the refund.
entities.notifyCustomer: Flag determining whether to email the customer about the refund.
entities.suggestedRefund: Calculated recommended refund amount for the return.
entities.transactions: Collection of payment transactions associated with the refund process.

entities.inventoryItemId: Unique identifier tracking the inventory item catalog record.
entities.inventoryLevelId: Unique identifier for inventory stock levels at a specific location.
entities.productId: Identifier for the product associated with the inventory item.
entities.variantId: Identifier for the product variant associated with the inventory item.
entities.locationId: Identifier for the warehouse or store location holding the inventory.
entities.available: Calculated count of stock available for purchase.
entities.quantity: Physical count of stock quantity on hand.
entities.quantities: Collection of stock quantities categorized by state (e.g., committed, available).
entities.delta: Numerical adjustment value added to or subtracted from stock levels.
entities.reason: Justification code explaining an inventory adjustment.
entities.referenceDocumentUri: Link to an external document or receipt referencing the inventory adjustment.
entities.compareQuantity: Baseline stock quantity used for validation checks during updates.

entities.discountId: Unique identifier for the discount promotion.
entities.discountCodeId: Identifier specific to a discount code instance.
entities.code: Alphanumeric text code entered at checkout to apply the discount.
entities.codes: Collection of valid discount codes associated with the promotion.
entities.title: Name or description of the discount campaign.
entities.startsAt: Timestamp marking when the discount becomes active.
entities.endsAt: Timestamp marking when the discount expires.
entities.status: Current active or inactive state of the discount.
entities.usageLimit: Maximum number of times the discount can be redeemed globally.
entities.customerId: Identifier restricting the discount to a specific customer.
entities.minimumRequirement: Conditions required for the discount to apply (e.g., minimum cart amount).
entities.customerGets: Definition of what benefit the customer receives from the discount.
entities.customerBuys: Definition of purchase requirements needed to trigger the discount.
entities.value: Numerical value or magnitude of the discount.
entities.percentage: Percentage discount rate applied to items.
entities.appliesOncePerCustomer: Restricts discount usage to a single time per customer account.
entities.combinesWith: Rules governing whether this discount can be stacked with others.
entities.entitledProductIds: List of products eligible to receive the discount.
entities.entitledVariantIds: List of specific variants eligible to receive the discount.
entities.entitledCollectionIds: List of collections eligible for the discount.
entities.prerequisiteProductIds: List of products required in cart to qualify for the discount.
entities.prerequisiteVariantIds: List of specific variants required in cart to qualify.
entities.prerequisiteCollectionIds: List of collections required in cart to qualify.
entities.prerequisiteCustomerIds: List of specific customers eligible to use the discount.

entities.locationId: Unique identifier for the business location or warehouse.
entities.name: Display name of the location.
entities.address: Full formatted address details of the location.
entities.address1: Primary street address line for the location.
entities.address2: Secondary street address line (suite, unit, building) for the location.
entities.city: City name where the location is situated.
entities.province: State, province, or region of the location.
entities.country: Country name where the location is based.
entities.countryCode: Two-letter ISO country code for the location.
entities.zip: Postal code or ZIP code of the location.
entities.phone: Contact telephone number for the location.
entities.active: Indicates whether the location is currently operational and active.
